title: My Very First World War (FCP 2026)
synopsis:
France, World War I. Justin, an illiterate farmer, is enrolled in the army. Knowing nothing of the world or the war, Justin finds himself on the front without understanding why. Naïve and open-minded, Justin will cross paths with a German pilot and a Senegalese soldier, escape a
prisoner camp and start a mutiny to prevent his comrades from risking their lives. Through his journey, Justin will question the absurdity of war, make lifelong friends and inspire many...

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 第一次世界大戰的法國，目不識丁的農夫 Justin 被徵召入伍。他對世界和戰爭一無所知，發覺自己身處前線，卻不明白為何而戰。他天真且思想開放，途中將遇到過德國飛行員和塞內加爾士兵，並逃出戰俘營，更曾為阻止同袍繼續白白冒生命危險而發動兵變。經歷了這一切，Justin 開始質疑戰爭的荒謬，結交到畢生摯友，並激勵了許多人......
